proof_obligations: Exhibit two allowed histories with the same worker-visible durable state and zero versus one inaccessible remote application.
Explain why retrying creates a duplicate in one history, whereas withholding application violates truthful/eventual completion in the other.
Keep the argument scoped to the documented non-deduplicating, write-only API and allowed crash/uncertainty model.
Necessary change restores a missing capability (durable deduplication/shared transaction/outcome query) or explicitly weakens safety/liveness.
finite_tests: A pass is not an impossibility proof or completed-code success; assess the full public contract and source.
